verdicts_or_reports.field: per-item trade-in with Keep one of each item enabled
verdicts_or_reports.expected: With 2 Iron Swords in inventory, one is reserved as the keeper and the other can still be sold, even though an Iron Sword is equipped.
verdicts_or_reports.observed: Tapping the Iron Sword row is blocked with an equipped warning. This occurred after selling one from the starting stack of 3; the row still showed 2 in inventory, so one surplus copy remained beyond the keeper.
verdicts_or_reports.observed_quote: Iron Sword is equipped. Unequip it first to sell.
steps: Open Shop > Sell with an equipped Iron Sword and 3 Iron Swords in inventory.
Turn on Keep one of each item.
Tap Iron Sword and sell one copy for 62 coins.
Verify the row now shows ×2 in inventory, then tap it again.

contains: Iron Sword is equipped. Unequip it first to sell.

verdicts_or_reports.expected: Iron Quota should be shown as completed; the supplied starting state lists Copper Run, Iron Quota, and Shrimp Haul as completed guild quests.
verdicts_or_reports.observed: Copper Run is marked Completed, but Iron Quota remains locked and is shown as requiring Guild Level 1. Reopening the Mining Guild board reproduces the same state.
steps: From Home, expand Town and open Guild Hall.
Compare Copper Run and Iron Quota against the supplied starting state: Copper Run shows Completed, while Iron Quota shows Requires Guild Level 1.
Return to Guild Hall and reopen Mining Guild; the same status remains.

verdicts_or_reports.field: toggle state and completed quest list
verdicts_or_reports.expected: Tapping the checked Hide completed switch again should turn it off and restore the completed quests to the board.
verdicts_or_reports.observed: After Hide completed is enabled and removes Copper Run and Iron Quota from the list, tapping the switch or its label again has no effect: it remains checked and the list still starts at Coal Haul. The filtered state also remains after leaving and reopening Mining Guild.
steps: Open Town > Guild Hall > Mining Guild. With Hide completed off, the list starts with Copper Run and Iron Quota.
Tap Hide completed once; the list updates to start with Coal Haul.
Tap Hide completed again using the switch, then tap it once more using the label.
Verify the switch remains checked and Copper Run and Iron Quota do not return; leave and reopen Mining Guild and verify the filtered state remains.

verdicts_or_reports.element: Enemy list below the All/Missing filters
verdicts_or_reports.expected: After rotating to landscape, the sort controls and enemy rows should remain reachable by scrolling.
verdicts_or_reports.observed: The landscape viewport stops after the All/Missing filters; the A–Z/By Location controls and all enemy rows are below the bottom navigation and never appear after repeated upward swipes in the content area.
steps: Open Profile > Bestiary > Enemies in portrait.
Swipe upward several times over the Bestiary content below the encounter progress bar.
Verify that only All and Missing are visible and no sort controls or enemy rows can be reached.
